name: com.theratesguy.www/policy-analysis
title: The Rates Guy
description: California auto policy term comparison, cited SR-22 & CDI filing guidance, and filing estimates.

tools.name: get_ratefoundry_estimate
tools.description: Compute a non-binding California car and auto insurance cost estimate (seguro de auto / aseguranza en California) for one driver and one owned vehicle with RateFoundry from CDI filing-derived data across California ZIP codes, 30/60/15 liability or full coverage (COMP/COLL), and owned-auto SR-22 scenarios. Ask for the user’s ZIP area, years licensed, marital status, known rating points, term, vehicle year, mileage, use and coverage; physical-damage coverage needs a deductible. Never infer rating points from tickets or eligibility for a discount. Show assumptions, filing provenance and unavailable programs. Non-owner SR-22 questions use get_california_insurance_guidance; this tool does not provide non-owner pricing. No VIN, contact information, policy purchase or lead submission. The Rates Guy presents analysis and an optional brand-owned website handoff. Server quota counters and payload-free usage records may change; no lead or policy is created.

zip_code.description: California ZIP area explicitly supplied by the user; never use device location or a street address.

years_licensed.description: Years licensed, explicitly supplied; do not derive from age.

points.description: Known carrier rating points; ask when unknown. Do not convert an accident/ticket to a point count.

product.description: Owned personal-auto only. Use get_california_insurance_guidance for non-owner guidance.

sr22_required.description: User-disclosed filing requirement. Omission assumes no filing and is disclosed.

good_driver.description: Use only a user-requested discount scenario; never determine eligibility. Omission applies no good-driver discount.

vehicle_year.description: Required for personal_auto; forbidden for named_non_owner.

annual_mileage.description: Required for personal_auto; user-supplied annual miles.

coverage.description: Required for personal_auto. Liability is 30/60/15. Physical damage adds COMP/COLL.

deductible.description: Required only for physical_damage; same COMP/COLL deductible.

tools.name: compare_policy_terms
tools.description: Compare two user-supplied California auto insurance quotes or policies side by side (6-month vs 12-month whole-term premiums, 30/60/15 or higher liability limits, and COMP/COLL deductibles; comparar pólizas de auto en California). Ask for the whole-term premium rather than installments. Show monthly equivalents and annualized arithmetic with coverage differences; never rank insurers or recommend eligibility. Null means absent or unknown, so do not infer matching coverage. No personal/contact, account, payment, VIN or policy-number data.

premium_total.description: User-supplied total premium for the entire stated policy term, not an installment or down payment.

comprehensive_deductible.description: Null when coverage is absent or unknown; clarify which. Zero means a disclosed zero deductible.

tools.name: get_california_insurance_guidance
tools.description: Explain California 30/60/15 minimum liability limits (vs special statutory programs like CLCA), SR-22 DMV filing rules, non-owner SR-22 without a car (SR-22 sin carro), or California Department of Insurance (CDI) rate filing status and rate hikes in English or Spanish (seguro de auto / SR-22 en California). No rating profile is needed. This is dated, bounded official-source guidance, not a live regulatory search, non-owner estimate, eligibility decision or a claim that a filing was approved.

tools.name: get_rates_guy_quote_link
tools.description: Return The Rates Guy separate California auto and SR-22 rate-check website link only when the user asks for that handoff. No form, lead, phone call, consent, policy purchase or referral to another brand is submitted.
